intro: Scripted, deterministic scenario on a fictional plant (config `configs/scenario.yaml`, seed 20261015). Days 1-3 are normal operation used to fit the detector; the scripted events follow. Use **Next ▶** to replay it step by step.

steps.title: Normal operation and a COMP1 motor start
steps.narrative: COMP1 starts at Thu 03:43 UTC. The 1-min average start-up current is higher than the running current, op_state = STARTING. Start-up transients are expected behaviour: SANAD suppresses alarms during start/stop. Result in this run: **no case** on COMP1 around the start.
steps.expect_no_case: No case raised: the start is recognised as normal.

steps.title: Real overload on COMP1
steps.narrative: The compressor load is raised to 1.25× rating for 40 min (scripted, illustrative). Both independent current paths (meter CT and relay CT) rise together, the winding temperature follows the thermal model and the bus balance holds — the fingerprint is clean. SANAD: **C00001 PHYSICAL_EQUIPMENT_FAULT/OVERLOAD (confidence 0.97, IMMEDIATE)**.

steps.title: CT drift on PUMP1 — naive vs SANAD-protected controller
steps.narrative: The PUMP1 feeder-meter CT drifts low by 6 %/day (scripted, illustrative). Inside the meter, P = √3·V·I·PF still holds (R1/R2 clean); only independent paths reveal it: R3 (meter vs relay CT) and R4 (bus balance). SANAD: **C00002 SENSOR_FAULT/DRIFT (confidence 0.89, APPROVAL)**. When confidence ≥ 0.85 the meter CT is QUARANTINED and the trusted stream carries a relay-based ESTIMATED current (third trace).
steps.controller: Over the drift window, the naive controller (raw meter) exceeds the group limit for **891 min** (max 4.3 A over); the SANAD-protected controller for **0 min** (max 0.0 A). Before SANAD's case opens, both controllers see the same (drifting) value.

steps.title: kWh falsification on AUX1 — SANAD abstains and escalates
steps.narrative: The AUX1 kWh register under-reports 25 % of its increments for 18 h (scripted, illustrative). The meter's own power (second trace: ∫P dt) and the bus energy balance disagree with the register (R5, R5B). AUX1 has a single meter, so only one independent witness exists. SANAD: **C00003 UNCERTAIN (confidence 0.97, APPROVAL)**. The data is held as SUSPECT and an operator decides; SANAD never accuses. Scripted operator action: OVERRIDE with reason “Register access log shows a firmware update on AUX1 meter; send to metering team, not a tampering case.”.

steps.title: Audit — verify the chain, then tamper
steps.narrative: Every verdict and the operator override are entries of an append-only, SHA-256 hash-chained log. Verification of the stored log: **chain intact (5 entries)**. Editing one entry (below, in memory) breaks the chain.
